info.name: HustleHub+ Final POE - Full API Test Suite
info.description:
Final-part API tests for HustleHub+: everything from Part 2 (validation, sanitisation, authentication, RBAC, ownership, security headers, error handling, rate limiting) PLUS the income/tax dashboard, token revocation, account lockout and the Admin audit trail.

Run with: npm run test:api (API must be running with ACCOUNT_LOCK_THRESHOLD=3; restart it between runs to reset in-memory rate limit counters).

7.1 Helmet headers present on a normal response

exec: pm.test('CSP default-src is none', function () { pm.expect(csp).to.include("default-src 'none'"); });
pm.test('CSP blocks scripts and styles', function () { pm.expect(csp).to.include("script-src 'none'"); pm.expect(csp).to.include("style-src 'none'"); });

pm.test('CSP forbids framing, base tag and form posts', function () { pm.expect(csp).to.include("frame-ancestors 'none'"); pm.expect(csp).to.include("base-uri 'none'"); pm.expect(csp).to.include("form-action 'none'"); });

pm.test('Strict-Transport-Security is set (>= 1 year)', function () { var m = (pm.response.headers.get('Strict-Transport-Security') || '').match(/max-age=(\d+)/); pm.expect(m).to.not.be.null; pm.expect(Number(m[1])).to.be.at.least(31536000); });
pm.test('Responses are not cacheable (Cache-Control: no-store)', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.include('no-store'); });

exec: pm.test('Untrusted origin is never allowed (header is not the evil origin and not *)', function () { pm.expect(acao).to.not.eql('https://evil.example'); pm.expect(acao).to.not.eql('*'); });

pm.test('Only the configured frontend origin is advertised, so browsers block the evil origin', function () { pm.expect(acao === undefined || acao === pm.collectionVariables.get('clientOrigin')).to.be.true; });

10 Final Part - Income Dashboard & Tax Estimate
10.1 Freelancer dashboard (current tax year) returns income and tax

exec: pm.test('Gross income equals the booked gig price', function () { pm.expect(d.summary.grossIncome).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('gigPrice')); pm.expect(d.summary.bookingCount).to.eql(1); });

pm.test('12 monthly buckets (Mar-Feb) that add up to the gross income', function () { pm.expect(d.monthly).to.have.lengthOf(12); var sum = d.monthly.reduce(function (a, m) { return a + m.income; }, 0); pm.expect(Math.round(sum * 100) / 100).to.eql(d.summary.grossIncome); });
pm.test('Top gigs list contains the booked gig', function () { pm.expect(d.topGigs).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; pm.expect(d.topGigs[0].income).to.eql(d.summary.grossIncome); });

pm.test('Tax block is complete: 7 SARS brackets, rebate, estimate', function () { pm.expect(d.tax.brackets).to.have.lengthOf(7); pm.expect(d.tax.primaryRebate).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(d.tax).to.include.keys('taxBeforeRebate', 'estimatedTax', 'effectiveRate', 'marginalRate', 'afterTaxIncome'); });

pm.test('Tax maths: 18% bracket less rebate, never negative, take-home = income - tax', function () { var expectedBefore = Math.round(d.summary.grossIncome * 0.18 * 100) / 100; pm.expect(d.tax.taxBeforeRebate).to.eql(expectedBefore); pm.expect(d.tax.estimatedTax).to.eql(Math.max(0, Math.round((expectedBefore - d.tax.primaryRebate) * 100) / 100)); pm.expect(d.tax.afterTaxIncome).to.eql(Math.round((d.summary.grossIncome - d.tax.estimatedTax) * 100) / 100); });
pm.test('Disclaimer says this is an estimate', function () { pm.expect(d.disclaimer).to.match(/estimate/i); });
